title: Hotels with a Milan Cathedral view: which room to book
metaDescription: Four Milan hotels with a room named for the Duomo, the exact category to book at each, and the look-alike rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Milan Cathedral view, and which room to book
dek: Four hotels in the centre of Milan, around the Duomo. For each one we list the room category that names the cathedral, and the courtyard, terrace and plain suites that look elsewhere.
teaser: Three hotels name the view in the room; the fourth names only the Duomo in its suite.

shortAnswer.label: One category, named for the cathedral

decoder.text: Both are double rooms at Amabilia Suites Milano. Expedia lists the courtyard room with no view tag and the cathedral room with a City view tag, so the name decides.
At SCF Collection – Duomo, the plain Suite has no view named on Expedia. Only the Suite con vista Duomo, which means suite with a Duomo view, is sold with the view.
Park Hyatt Milano sells a Suite, Terrace with a City view tag only. Its Suite (Duomo) is the category that names the cathedral, though the name leaves out the word view.

faq.q: Which Milan hotels sell rooms with a view of the Duomo?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026, four sell a room category with the cathedral in its name: Rosa Grand Milano, Amabilia Suites Milano, SCF Collection – Duomo and Park Hyatt Milano. Only the first three say view in the name.

faq.q: Why does a booking site say City view for a Duomo room?
faq.a: The view tag on a booking site is a generic label. Expedia tags the Double Room (Cathedral view) at Amabilia Suites Milano as City view, and the Suite (Duomo) at Park Hyatt Milano the same way. The room name is the promise.

faq.q: Is the Duomo Deluxe Terrace Apartment a room with a view?
faq.a: Its name at Rosa Grand Milano says Duomo, but Expedia shows no view tag for it. A travel guide says the Duomo Deluxe Terrace apartments overlook the spires of the cathedral, so ask the hotel which one you will get.
